about: [O1] The drive-through (brief O1 §7): from Grand Ave a driver drives a loop through every district by real keys (tools/lib/o1_city.mjs 'drive': the road graph's route, the right lane, W / S / A / D) - no frame over 50 ms, no chunk missing within 100 m of the eye, none built late (within 110 m), nothing driven through (never inside a wall's box), every district reached. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1_drive.json
